name: Lasaco Assurance PLC
source: LASACO Assurance Plc, Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss, 31 December 2025, p.39 of the NGX filing (N thousands). The stored Revenue, Cost of Sales and Gross Profit were 1000x the printed figures; they now carry the printed insurance revenue 29,981,521, the insurance service expense plus reinsurance 32,053,451 and the insurance service result (2,071,930), and the printed Operating expenses (7,669,864) was added
source_note: Income Tax was stored negative for two tax CHARGE amounts, which made Profit before tax minus Income tax disagree with the printed loss after tax. The FY2025 results at a glance prints insurance revenue 29,981,521, insurance service expenses plus net reinsurance expense 32,053,451 and the insurance service result -2,071,930, loss before tax -2,977,642, tax 94,819 and loss after tax -3,072,461, all in N thousands, so the charge is 94,819,000 and the loss after tax is -3,072,461,000. Both years now tie exactly. The published FY2025 statement is marked unaudited. H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47481_LASACO_ASSURANCE_PLC.-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled.
